findings.issue: Every bytes copy of solc 0.6's ABI coder (abi.decode of a bytes member from memory, the encodings of the retryable-ticket calldata) is a word loop followed by a zeroing mask of the last partial word: 9 whiles and 10 mask expressions for what are copy lines.
